items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Lewis is my favorite. Yeah. Always was.

ctx.x: Lewis is my favorite. Yeah. Always was. And the boy that I admire a lot now is Dave, Buddy Petit. That's the fellow I really did admire last year. And come to Plan Epsom thing, well, I thought about Johnny Ducks. Always did. You know, got to tell the truth about it.
Well, when you were young, who was your favorite trumpet player when you were a kid?
